issues.description: Low stock, quickly, recipients and notification interface are unspecified.

inconsistencies.description: The implementation rejects requested == stock although the requirement accepts it.
The existing equal-stock test expects an exception contrary to the requirement.

behaviors.description: A request below stock returns stock minus requested.
Requesting exactly the available stock returns zero.
Zero stock and zero requested returns zero.
A request above stock raises ValueError.
Either negative integer argument raises ValueError.
Either non-int argument, including bool, raises TypeError.
